name: Exp_BykovTrend_ColorX2MA_MMRec
summary: This EA uses the BykovTrend signal indicator combined with a ColorX2MA (double moving average with color) filter to generate trade entries, and implements a Martingale-style money management recovery system that increases lot size after consecutive losses. It opens positions based on indicator confluence and escalates position size to recover previous losses. The strategy is a trend-following entry with aggressive position sizing recovery mechanics.
summary_zh: 该EA使用BykovTrend信号指标结合ColorX2MA双均线颜色过滤器生成交易入场信号，并实现了马丁格尔式资金管理恢复系统，在连续亏损后加倍仓位。它基于指标共振开仓，并通过递增仓位来恢复前期亏损。策略本质是趋势跟踪入场配合激进仓位恢复机制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA结合BykovTrend信号指标和ColorX2MA双色均线过滤器进行趋势跟踪交易，当两者方向一致时开仓。入场条件：BykovTrend发出买入或卖出信号，且ColorX2MA均线的颜色方向与信号一致时进场。出场条件：通过反向信号平仓或达到止损/止盈目标，也可能通过追踪止损出场。仓位管理：采用马丁格尔恢复机制（MMRec），在亏损后按倍数或比例增加下一笔交易的仓位大小，试图通过更大的盈利交易来弥补之前的损失。资金管理：根据账户余额和设定的风险参数计算初始仓位，但亏损后的仓位递增使得整体风险呈指数级增长。这种策略在连续亏损时会面临极大的回撤风险，属于高风险高回报的交易方式。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines the BykovTrend signal indicator with a ColorX2MA double moving average color filter for trend-following trades, entering positions when both indicators align in the same direction. Entry conditions require a BykovTrend buy or sell signal confirmed by the ColorX2MA moving average color matching the signal direction. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals, stop loss or take profit levels being hit, or potentially by trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing employs a Martingale recovery system (MMRec) that increases lot size after losing trades, attempting to recover previous losses with a single larger winning trade. Money management calculates initial lots based on account balance and risk parameters, but the post-loss lot escalation creates exponentially increasing risk exposure. This approach faces extreme drawdown risk during consecutive losing streaks, making it a high-risk, high-reward trading method.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, starting volume of martingale sequence

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Group take profit target amount (in currency)

parameters.name: MMRec_Klot
parameters.description: 马丁格尔恢复倍数系数

parameters.name: MMRec_MaxLots
parameters.description: 马丁格尔恢复最大手数限制
parameters.description_en: Martingale recovery maximum lot size limit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0为不启用
parameters.description_en: Fixed-point trailing stop, 0 means use SAR trailing

pros: 双指标确认机制（BykovTrend + ColorX2MA）减少假信号，提高入场质量
马丁格尔恢复系统在短期内能有效回补亏损，适合低频连续亏损场景
设有最大手数限制（MMRec_MaxLots），一定程度上控制了极端风险
代码结构清晰，参数化设计便于优化调整
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation (BykovTrend + ColorX2MA) reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Martingale recovery system effectively recoups losses in the short term, suitable for low-frequency consecutive loss scenarios
Maximum lot size cap (MMRec_MaxLots) provides some protection against extreme risk exposure
Clean code structure with parameterized design allows easy optimization and adjustment
cons: 马丁格尔仓位递增在连续亏损时会导致指数级风险增长，可能爆仓
止损默认为0，意味着如果未手动设置则完全依赖反向信号平仓，风险极高
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下频繁交易会侵蚀利润
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
马丁格尔策略本质上需要无限资金假设，在有限账户中不可持续
cons_en: Martingale position escalation creates exponentially increasing risk during consecutive losses, potentially leading to account blowup
Stop loss defaults to 0, meaning full reliance on opposing signals for exit if not manually set, creating extreme risk
No spread filter mechanism means frequent trading in high-spread environments erodes profits
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated entries within the same candle
Martingale strategy inherently requires an infinite capital assumption, making it unsustainable in finite accounts
improvements: 增加强制止损设置，不允许止损为0，防止无止损持仓风险
将马丁格尔恢复系统改为固定比例加仓或半马丁模式（1.5倍而非2倍），降低连续亏损时的风险敞口
增加新K线检查和点差过滤，避免同一K线重复开仓和高点差滑点损失
增加最大连续亏损次数限制，达到后重置手数为初始值，防止无限递增
improvements_en: Enforce mandatory stop loss setting, disallowing zero values to prevent unprotected position risk
Replace full Martingale with fixed-ratio scaling or semi-Martingale (1.5x instead of 2x) to reduce risk exposure during consecutive losses
Add new bar check and spread filter to prevent repeated entries on the same candle and high-spread slippage losses
Add maximum consecutive loss count limit that resets lot size to initial value when reached, preventing unlimited escalation

risk_points: 马丁格尔仓位倍增机制在连续亏损时会导致指数级仓位增长，极易爆仓
默认止损为0，持仓完全依赖反向信号，存在长时间浮亏风险
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一K线重复开仓，放大风险敞口
risk_points_en: Martingale lot doubling mechanism creates exponential position growth during consecutive losses,easily leading to account liquidation
Default stop loss of 0 means positions rely entirely on opposing signals, creating prolonged drawdown risk
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated entries within the same candle, amplifying risk exposure

summary_en: This EA uses the BykovTrend signal indicator combined with a ColorX2MA (double moving average with color) filter to generate trade entries, and implements a Martingale-style money management recovery system that increases lot size after consecutive losses. It opens positions based on indicator confluence and escalates position size to recover previous losses. The strategy is a trend-following entry with aggressive position sizing recovery mechanics.
